api-client.summary: API client correctly implements OpenRouter integration with proper error handling
notes: Bearer token authentication from OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable
Comprehensive error handling for auth, timeout, network, rate limit, and server errors
Proper HTTPError and URLError handling with user-friendly messages

prompt-engineering.summary: Prompt engineering module provides comprehensive guidance for AI script generation
notes: System prompt clearly instructs AI to generate only executable Blender Python code
Includes detailed bpy API documentation and patterns
Multiple prompt templates for different generation types (primitive, material, modifier, etc.)
Generation type auto-detection based on keywords
Script extraction and validation functions included

generate-operator.summary: Generate operator correctly connects UI to API with proper flow control
notes: Operator poll method validates prompt (not empty, <= 1000 chars)
API key validation before making API calls
Successful generations stored in history with timestamp
Error messages displayed through Blender's report system and status field
Proper use of UNDO option for operations
